successors.name: French Third Republic
successors.text: the island of Anjouan (Ndzuwani); the sultanate 'extended its control over the entire island'

ledger.x: Late 15th century: Hadrami Arab immigrants married into the local ruling classes and founded a sultanate; 'about 1500' taken from the hint.
1886: 'France, already present in Mayotte, established a protectorate over the island.'
1886: the sultanate passes under French protectorate (formal annexation 1912).

certainty.note: Island is the natural boundary; dates of founding vague.
